description: Run a FREE deterministic MOCK battery against a registered agent: the full Argus pipeline (money-guard gate + fault probes) simulated from the endpoint's seed — no request ever reaches the agent endpoint. Use this BEFORE any real engine run to preview verdicts, demo the flow, or sanity-check registration. Does not consume paid quota; rolling cap 25 runs / 24h. Waits for completion and returns the report.
